morphs.phenology_guard: Require flowering overlap with coloured comparison for Aim2 pollinator choice; otherwise retain for Aim1/Aim3 only.
No morph-specific phenology prior currently frozen.

decision_rule: Do not add populations from a taxonomic form name alone. A public morph-locality layer becomes decision-capable only when at least two independent spatial cells survive exact source-name filtering and can be projected into the parent species niche space. Even then, exact field localities remain field-verified and P013/P014 must first be placed before activating a second matched W/C pair.
claim_boundary: GBIF records can support public morph-locality hypotheses but cannot verify current population persistence, flower colour of an unvouchered occurrence, collecting permission, or reproductive overlap.
